<MethodEndpoint method={'event'} path={'webhook'} context={'endpoint'}></MethodEndpoint>

polaris-email POSTs a `WebhookEnvelope` to each matching subscription URL.
The request carries `X-Polaris-Sig: <hex>` signed over
`polaris-webhook\nPOST\n<path>\n<canonical-query>\n<ts>\n<nonce>\n<sha256-hex(body)>`
with the subscription's secret. Verify with the SDK
`verifyWebhook(...)` helper.
